Whoa?! ...T-That's Tolala! He's my rival.\nTolala! Are you alright?!
Pelulu?! I don't need your...
Pelulu?! I don't need your...\nAagh!! Ouch...
Ouch... Um?
Nooooo!!
So, how does it feel to be saved by a rival, huh?
Shut up!\nIt was not you who saved my life!
...Well, thank you for saving my life.\nNot you! But, this adventurer!
Sure, I know. But, you must return a favor, right?\nOh, yea! The lifesaver wants to know about\nthe mage who creates holy gems.
You know, it's not me who wanna listen.\nI'm standing here just by chance!\nHee hee hee!
That's playing dirty! Fine!\nCould you tell me what you wanna know about\nthe mage, please?!
...Naiata?? Umm, I've heard of her name but\nI have no idea where she is now...
Oh yea?\nYou're playing dumb, aren't ya?
No, I'm not! I just heard the name from\na Resistle merchant who sells holy gems...
Yea, right. You should ask him about her.\nHis name is Tecaca.
He's a strange person. I saw him going to\nFiery Volcano just a few days ago. He was looking\nfor something. He might still be there I guess.
Let's go and see then. Thanks for the info!
If it's a lie, you will pay for it!\nSee ya!
Keep your mouth shut! I wasn't telling it to you!!\nYou'll get nothing even if you come to me later!!
Hey, Tolala! How could you deceive us!?\nWe couldn't find a single trace of Tecaca\nanywhere there!
It's not my fault!\nI really saw him enter the volcano area.
But think about it!\nHe may have got out of there already! It's none of\nmy business if he's still there or not!!
Grrrr! How dare you speak to me like that!?
Huh? Then, where is he?\n...Hmm, I have no idea.
As I said, Tecaca is quite an odd person.\nHe opens his shop at places people don't\nusually visit...
So, he might be in [ffff64]Yorl Highlands[ffffff]...
There he goes again with his nonsense...\nWhat? You wanna go there!? Are you serious!?
...Well, we have no other clues, but...\n...Fine! Let's go!!
Don't blame me if you can't find him!
Whoa?! Not again!\nTecaca wasn't there, right?
How do you know he wasn't there?!\nSo, you...!
Ugh! N-No! You got it all wrong! I met Tecaca\na little while ago. He said he was going to\nScaro Town. He was in a hurry...
H-He was not listening to me... He was mumbling\nthat he had an important task and he had to go\nthere no matter what... Ugg... I can't breathe!
Scaro Town... We went there before but there was\nnothing except monsters, right?\nWhy did he...
Hmm... It's no use thinking about it.\nLet's just go to Scaro Town.
Y-You almost killed me!\nI hope you get eaten by the monsters!
Whoa?! It's been a while!!
Oh my!\nWhat are you doing here?
We? We've just finished helping a new young\nadventurer and escorted him.\nWhat brought you here?
What?! Navida? That small world has returned to\nits original place?!
Hey hey, Tenert! That's not the topic!!\nA serious incident occurred there!
Nicola was frozen by monsters and held hostage?!\nMy gosh...
Guys, pack your bags.\nWe'll collect Burning Liquid with the adventurer\nand head to Navida to release the Xmas Knights!
That's the spirit! Understood!!
Okay!
The monsters at Fiery Volcano should have Burning\nLiquid. Let's move right now!!
